Capability

An enquiry is not yet a booking.

Calls, messages and quotation requests have different value. A straightforward tracking process can connect marketing sources to business feedback when the required information is actually available.

SCOPE AND TRANSPARENCY

What this does — and doesn't — promise

No invisible tracking or unauthorised data collection. Any measurement tools must be approved and properly configured.

Common questions

What if the customer doesn't say where they came from?

Multiple signals may help, but perfect attribution cannot be promised.

Do we need an expensive CRM?

Not always. A simple, consistently maintained pipeline may be sufficient at first.
